card: Adds explicit @file and @brief Doxygen commands to header comment blocks across 12 files. Currently, Doxygen attaches comments lacking @file to the subsequent code declaration or macro rather than the file, corrupting generated documentation. This clean-up was requested during review of PR #36805 and is noted as required by it.
evidence: PR description: 'Doxygen attaches a comment block that lacks a `@file` command to the next declaration rather than to the file.'
PR description notes it was requested during review on PR #36805 and is required for PR #36805.
problem: Without an explicit `@file` command, Doxygen attaches file-level comment blocks to the subsequent declaration or macro rather than the file itself. Additionally, when a comment starts with the filename directly following `@file`, Doxygen treats it as the filename identifier and omits it from generated documentation text.

risk.why: Touches only Doxygen header comments and documentation formatting, which does not affect compiled behavior.

scope_notes: Small documentation-only changes across 12 header files; also moves a comment block inside include guards in subprocess.h to simplify include guard linting.
summary: Fix Doxygen file-level comment formatting across headers by adding explicit `@file` and `@brief` commands. This ensures Doxygen attributes top-level header comments to the file itself instead of attaching them to the first declaration or macro, and avoids dropping leading file names in documentation.
